'''March''' was a short and pudgy [[alien]] criminal.<ref name="JLD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When we first read the Solo script there was an alien called March. I can't remember exactly what he did - local crimelord, gang boss or something like that. We only did a handful of ideas before his scene got rewritten and he ceased to exist.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="JLD" />}}
According to [[Jake Lunt Davies]], March was an alien criminal leader slated to appear in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' early in the development of the story, before having its scene ultimately cut from the final film.<ref name="JLD" />
